subject: question about using UNSTRUCTURED_CORR_t, why are my parameter estimates and nll.cov() different

messages.subject: question about using UNSTRUCTURED_CORR_t, why are my parameter estimates and nll.cov() different
parts:
Hello,

I've attached really simple simulation script and cpp in hopes that someone might be able to explain why the parameter vector for the covariances and the parameters of the covariance matrix from the UNSTRUCTURED_CORR_t object are different. Seems like based on my code they should be the same,

  PARAMETER_VECTOR(theta); //observation error
  UNSTRUCTURED_CORR_t<Type> nll(theta);

rep$theta == rep$'nll.cov'

Thanks,
Brandon
